40000683.author: पदार्थः
40000683.content: राजशार्दूल: great king, विश्वामित्रस्य Visvamitra's, तत् भाषितम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुहूर्तमिव for a moment, निस्संज्ञ: lost his senses, संज्ञावान् regained his consciousness, इदम् अब्रवीत् thus spoke.

40000683.author: Translation
40000683.content: On hearing Viswamitra, words the tiger among kings (Dasaratha) lost his senses for a moment  and  on regaining his consciousness spoke this way.

40000684.author: पदार्थः
40000684.content: राजीवलोचन: lotuseyed, मे राम: my Rama, ऊनषोडशवर्ष: in lessthan sixteen years of age, अस्य for him, राक्षसै:सह with the rakshasas, युद्धयोग्यताम् abilities to fight in a battle, न पश्यामि I do not see.

40000684.author: Translation
40000684.content: "My lotuseyed son Rama is less than sixteen. I do not think  he has ability to fight with the rakshasas in a battle.

40000685.author: पदार्थः
40000685.content: पूर्णा completely, इयम् अक्षौहिणी this Akshauhini, यस्या: for which, अहं I, पति: am the lord, ईश्वर: sustainer, अनया with this Akshauhini, संवृत: accompanied  by, गत्वा having gone, अहं I, तै:निशाचरै: with those night rangers, rakshasas, योद्धा will engage in the battle.

40000685.author: Translation
40000685.content: Here is the whole akshauhini (army) of which I am the lord and sustainer. Accompanied  by the  akshauhini I shall engage those rakshsasas in the battle.

40000686.author: पदार्थः
40000686.content: मे भृत्या: my servants, इमे these warriors, शूराश्च also valiant, विक्रान्ता: powerful, अस्त्रविशारदा: those skilled in use of weapons, रक्षोगणै: multitude of rakshasas, योद्धुम् to engage in battle, योग्या: are fit, रामम् Rama, नेतुम् नार्हसि not proper on your part to take him.

40000686.author: Translation
40000686.content: These servants of mine are warriors, valiant, powerful and courageous, skilled in the use of weapons and fit to engage multitude of rakshasas in battle. It is not proper to take Rama with you.

40000687.author: पदार्थः
40000687.content: अहमेव I myself, धनुष्पाणि: with a bow in hand, गोप्ता will protect, यावत् as long as, प्राणान् my life, धरिष्यामि I sustain, तावत् till such time, समरमूर्धनि on the battlefield, निशाचरै: with rakshasas, योत्स्ये will engage in the battle.

40000687.author: Translation
40000687.content: Wielding bow in hand I will protect the sacrifice. As long as my life sustains, I will engage the rakshasas in the battle.

40000688.author: पदार्थः
40000688.content: अहम् I, तत्र there, आगमिष्यामि shall come, सा व्रतचर्या that observance of vows,सुरक्षिता will be well protected, निर्विघ्ना without obstacles, भविष्यति will continue, रामम् Rama, नेतुम् to take, नार्हसि it is not proper on your part.

40000688.author: Translation
40000688.content: . I shall go there, protect the sacrifice and see that it is conducted without obstacles. It is not proper to take Rama with you.

40000689.author: पदार्थः
40000689.content: हि indeed, बाल: a child, अकृतविद्यश्च is not learned in the science of warfare, बलाबलम् strengths and weaknesses, न वेत्ति does not know, अस्त्रबलसंयुक्त:च न  has not acquired the strength of weapons, युद्धविशारद: च न not proficient in warfare, असौ he, रक्षसाम् of  rakshasas, योग्य:न is not qualified, ते those rakshasas, ध्रुवम् certainly, कूटयुद्धा: हि are  deceitful in battle.

40000689.author: Translation
40000689.content: Rama is still a child, he is not learned in the science of warfare,he does not know the  strength and weakness of enemies. He has not acquired  as yet the strength of using  weapons and is not proficient in warfare. You know certainly those rakshasas are deceitful in battle. And hence he is not qualified to oppose them in the battle succesfully.

40000690.author: पदार्थः
40000690.content: रामेण from Rama, विप्रयुक्त: separated, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, जीवितुम् to live, नोत्सहे I do not like, मुनिशार्दूल O Best of ascetics, रामम् Rama, नेतुम् to take, नार्हसि it is not proper on your part (You should not take).

40000690.author: Translation
40000690.content: Separated from Rama, I do not like to live even for a moment. O tiger among ascetics, it is not proper to take Rama with you.

40000691.author: पदार्थः
40000691.content: सुव्रत O Sage of excellent vows, ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, वा or, राघवम् Rama, नेतुम् to take him, इच्छसि you are intending, चतुरङ्गसमायुक्तम् my army consiting of elephants, chariots, cavalry and infantry, मया च सहितम् along with me, नय you may take.

40000691.author: Translation
40000691.content: O sage of great vows, O brahman if at all you intend to take Rama with you, take me  also along with my army.

40000692.author: पदार्थः
40000692.content: कौशिक O Scion of Kusika family, जातस्य having born, मम for me, षष्टि: sixty, वर्षसहस्राणि thousand years passed, अयम् this Rama, दु:खेन with great efforts, उत्पादित: is obtained,  रामम् Rama, नेतुम् to take him, नार्हसि it is not proper for you.

40000692.author: Translation
40000692.content: O scion of of Kusika family, sixty thousand years have passed since I was born.  Rama was born to me after a great deal of suffering. It is not proper to take him with you.

40000693.author: पदार्थः
40000693.content: चतुर्णाम् among the four, आत्मजानाम् sons, मम for me, परमिका great, प्रीति: हि affection           indeed, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, धर्मप्रधानम् च with virtue as prime qualification, रामम् Rama, नेतुम् to take, नार्हसि it is not proper.

40000693.author: Translation
40000693.content: My love for Rama among all my four sons is supreme.It is not proper for you to take Rama, the eldest son whose prime qualification  is his virtue.

40000694.author: पदार्थः
40000694.content: मुनिपुङ्गव O Best of sages, ते राक्षसा: those rakshsas, किंवीर्या how powerful?, कस्य whose, पुत्रा: sons?, ते they, के who?, कथंप्रमाणा: how much is the size of their body, एतान् them, के who, रक्षन्ति are protecting.

40000694.author: Translation
40000694.content: O best of sages, how powerful are those rakshsas? Whose  sons are they? Who are they and how huge is their body? Who are protecting them?

40000695.author: पदार्थः
40000695.content: ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, कूटयोधिनाम् of those treacherous and deceitful warriors, तेषाम् रक्षसाम् in the matter of those rakshasas, रामेण by Rama, मामकै: my, बलै: वा with forces, मया वा by me, कथम् how, प्रतिकर्तव्यम् to retaliate.

40000695.author: Translation
40000695.content: O brahman, how to rebuff those deceitful warriors either through Rama or through my army or through me?

40000696.author: पदार्थः
40000696.content: भगवन् O Venerable one, दुष्टभावानाम् of the wicked natured, तेषाम् of them, मया by me, रणे in the battle, कथम् how, स्थातव्यम् to stay, सर्वम् all this matter, मे to me, शंस tell, राक्षसा: rakshasas, वीर्योत्सिक्ता: proud of their prowess, तस्य his, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, विश्वामित्र: Viswamitra, अभ्यभाषत spoke.

40000696.author: Translation
40000696.content: O venerable one, how to fight those wickednatured ones in the battle and stay aginst them? For rakshasas are proud of their prowess". Having heard the words of Dasaratha, Viswamitra said:

40000697.author: पदार्थः
40000697.content: भगवन् O Venerable one, दुष्टभावानाम् of the wicked natured, तेषाम् of them, मया by me, रणे in the battle, कथम् how, स्थातव्यम् to stay, सर्वम् all this matter, मे to me, शंस tell, राक्षसा: rakshasas, वीर्योत्सिक्ता: proud of their prowess, तस्य his, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, विश्वामित्र: Viswamitra, अभ्यभाषत spoke.

40000697.author: Translation
40000697.content: O venerable one, how to fight those wickednatured ones in the battle and stay aginst them? For rakshasas are proud of their prowess". Having heard the words of Dasaratha, Viswamitra said:

40000698.author: पदार्थः
40000698.content: पौलस्त्यवंशप्रभव: born in the illustrious race of Pulastya, रावणो नाम by name Ravana, राक्षस: rakshasa, महाबल: of great strength, महावीर्य: of great prowess, स: he, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, दत्तवर: by boon granted, बहुभि: by several, राक्षसै: by rakshasas, वृत: accompanied, त्रैलोक्यम् three worlds, भृशम् excessively, बाधते is tormenting.

40000698.author: Translation
40000698.content: A rakshasa named Ravana, born in the illustrious race of Pulastya, of great strength and prowess and granted a boon by Brahma, accompanied by many rakshasas, is grievously tormenting the three worlds.

40000699.author: पदार्थः
40000699.content: साक्षात् evidently, वैश्रवणभ्राता brother of Kubera, विश्रवस:मुने: ascetic Visrava's, पुत्र: son, राक्षसाधिप: king of rakshasas, रावण: Ravana, महावीर्य: of great prowess, श्रूयते it is heard.

40000699.author: Translation
40000699.content: Ravana, king of rakshasas, is the brother of Kubera and son of ascetic Visravana. He is said to possess great prowess.

40000700.author: पदार्थः
40000700.content: महाबल: he, possessing great strength, यदा when, स्वयम् on his own, यज्ञस्य for sacrifice, विघ्नकर्ता न does not create impediments, तेन by, सञ्चोदितौ prompted, मारीचश्च Maricha, सुबाहुश्च Subahu, द्वौ राक्षसौ two rakshasas, यज्ञविघ्नम् obsctacles of sacrifice, करिष्यत: cause.

40000700.author: Translation
40000700.content: Although endowed with great strength, Ravana, by himself, never created impediments to the sacrifice. But two rakshasas by name Maricha and Subahu are incited by him to cause obstacles".

40000701.author: पदार्थः
40000701.content: महाबल: he, possessing great strength, यदा when, स्वयम् on his own, यज्ञस्य for sacrifice, विघ्नकर्ता न does not create impediments, तेन by, सञ्चोदितौ prompted, मारीचश्च Maricha, सुबाहुश्च Subahu, द्वौ राक्षसौ two rakshasas, यज्ञविघ्नम् obsctacles of sacrifice, करिष्यत: cause.

40000701.author: Translation
40000701.content: Although endowed with great strength, Ravana, by himself, never created impediments to the sacrifice. But two rakshasas by name Maricha and Subahu are incited by him to cause obstacles".

40000702.author: पदार्थः
40000702.content: इति in this manner, तेन मुनिना by that sage, उक्त: spoken, राजा king Dasaratha, तदा then, मुनिम् addressing the sage, उवाच said, सङ्ग्रामे in the battle, तस्य दुरात्मन: of that evil minded one, स्थातुम् to stand, शक्त: न अस्मि I am not capable.

40000702.author: Translation
40000702.content: Informed in this manner by sage Viswamitra, king Dasaratha addressed the sage,  saying, "I am not competent enough to stand before those evilminded rakshasas in the batlle".

40000703.author: पदार्थः
40000703.content: धर्मज्ञ O Knower of truth, स:त्वम् such of you, मम to me, पुत्रके in the little son, अल्पभाग्यस्य of the unfortunate, मम च in my matter, प्रसादम् favour,  कुरुष्व extend, गुरु: spiritual preceptor, भवान् you, दैवतं हि verily god.

40000703.author: Translation
40000703.content: "You are the knower of righteousness. Extend your favour to my little son and also to me for I am so who is unfortunate. You are verily my spiritual preceptor and god.

40000704.author: पदार्थः
40000704.content: देवदानवगन्धर्वा: gods, danavas and gandharvas, यक्षा: yakshas, पतगपन्नगा: birds and great serpents, युधि in the battle, रावणम् Ravana, सोढुम् to endure him, न शक्ता: are not capable, मानवा: men, किं पुन: again to say.

40000704.author: Translation
40000704.content: Gods, danavas, gandharvas, yakshas, birds and great serpents cannot withstand Ravana in battle. What are men to him? (They are no match to him).

40000705.author: पदार्थः
40000705.content: स: राक्षस: that rakshasa, युधि in the battle, वीर्यवताम् of the warriors, वीर्यम् prowess, आदत्ते हि takes, मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Foremost of ascetics, सबलो वा either with forces, मम आत्मजै:सहितो वा or together with my sons, अहम् I, तेन with him, तस्य बलै:वा  or with his forces, संयोद्धुम् to engage in battle, न शक्तोऽस्मि I am not competant.

40000705.author: Translation
40000705.content: That rakshasa pulls out warriors' prowess in the battle. O foremost of ascetics Either with forces or with my sons it is not possible for me to engage him or his forces in battle.

40000706.author: पदार्थः
40000706.content: ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, अमरप्रख्यम् resembling celestial deities, सङ्ग्रामाणाम् in the warfare, अकोविदम् not experienced, बालं पुत्रकम् dear young child, मे my, तनयम् son, कथमपि how so ever, नैव दास्यामि I never, never give him.

40000706.author: Translation
40000706.content: O brahman although my son resembles the celestials he is not experienced in warfare. On no account shall I spare him.

40000707.author: पदार्थः
40000707.content: अथ and, ते you, यज्ञविघ्नकरौ those causing obstacles to sacrifice, सुन्दोपसुन्दयो: of Sunda and Upasunda, सुतौ तौ sons, युध्दे in the battle, कालोपमौ resemble god of death, Yama, पुत्रकम् my son, नैव दास्यामि I shall never part with him.

40000707.author: Translation
40000707.content: Further the sons of Sunda and Upasunda by name Maricha and Subahu are causing obstacles to your sacrifice. They resemble the god of death, Yama. I shall never part with my son.

40000708.author: पदार्थः
40000708.content: मारीचश्च Maricha, सुबाहुश्च Subahu, वीर्यवन्तौ possessed of prowess, सुशिक्षितौ experienced  in warfare, अहम् I, ससुहृद्गण: with my best friends, तयो: in them, अन्यतरेण with one of them, योध्दा स्याम् can combat.

40000708.author: Translation
40000708.content: Maricha and Subahu not only possess prowess but also are experienced in warfare. Together with my group of friends I can combat with one of the two".

40000709.author: पदार्थः
40000709.content: इति in this manner, नरपतिजल्पनात् with the statements of king Dasaratha, द्विजेन्द्रम् Indra among ascetics, कुशिकसुतम् son of Kusika, सुमहान् great, मन्यु: rage, विवेश entered, महर्षिवह्नि: fire in the form of maharshi, मखे in the sacrifice, सुहुत: with good offerings of  oblation, आज्यसिक्त: sprinkled with clarified butter, अग्नि:इव like  sacrificial fire, उज्वलित: समभवत् blazed.

40000709.author: Translation
40000709.content: Having heard the statements of the king the son of Kusika, Viswamitra who was like Indra among the ascetics was seized by great anger. As though fire in the form of  maharshi blazed like the sacrificial fire into which oblations of clarified butter have been poured. ।। iऋफफछफौ चफळउफp८फउफफऋफhफॊ खफफऔउफळE१ळऋफ फबn८E१फखऋफॊ अफफऔफE१फhbॊ६ भखफघफजजफMफऩ ityढऍ डrंmadraचऍ vmंkंya ikyऍ bakङऍ viनडassargaध৷৷ Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
